exact_statement: For the eight independent unmarked-edge variables of K5 minus edges 34 and marked 03, prove that the endpoint-connectivity polynomial xi_03 is positive on the distinguished Garding component of the deletion polynomial P, or give an exact point in that component with xi_03<=0.
non_success_conditions: a P>0 point without exact component membership
local Hessian sign without global continuation
scope_notes: The inherited five-variable theorem proves xi_03>0 only after equalizing edge pairs {01,02}, {13,23}, and {14,24}.
The vertex swap 1<->2 reverses all three transverse differences simultaneously; it does not give independent pairwise symmetries.
A full eight-variable marked-host theorem would be a standalone local lemma, not OPG-1757 or global_interface_closed.
A negative xi point counts only with an exact path or complete chamber proof placing it in the distinguished component of P>0.
